spellbook.finance/limitations: Delegated writes require the workspace owner role, and membership remains backend-enforced.
A sale cannot be undone through this tool. Confirm the printing, finish, condition and quantity with the person before calling it.
The call is refused with insufficient_inventory when fewer unsold copies exist than qty, and it then sells nothing.
Delisting from marketplaces is best-effort. A channel that fails is retried automatically, so a copy can stay live for a few minutes after the sale is recorded.
The price is the customer's own statement. SpellBook verifies no payment and no delivery.

description: Record a sale of cards the seller's workspace holds that happened outside SpellBook's order intake, such as a local game store buy, an in-person trade, or a one-off marketplace sale SpellBook did not import. Names the exact printing, finish, condition, quantity and unit sale price. It marks that many copies sold, oldest first, closes the position so spellbook_inventory_holdings and spellbook_buy_outcome_report reflect it, and pulls those copies off every marketplace where they are still live. Returns the sold item ids and the holding after the sale.

binId.description: Sell only copies from this bin. Omit to take the oldest copies from any bin.

buyerName.description: The buyer's name as the customer stated it. Optional.

condition.description: The condition of the sold copies, matching how they were recorded. Required.

finish.description: The finish of the sold copies, matching the finish recorded in inventory. Pokemon supports nf (Normal/Unlimited), fo (Holofoil), rh (Reverse Holofoil), 1e (1st Edition) and 1e-fo (1st Edition Holofoil). Required.

marketplace.description: Where the sale happened. in_person covers a store buy or a trade. Required.

note.description: A free-text note stored with the sale. Optional.

occurredAt.description: When the sale happened, as an ISO-8601 timestamp. Omit to use the time of this call.

orderId.description: A stable reference for this sale, such as the buyer's order number or a receipt number. Required. A second call with the same orderId for the same printing, finish and condition returns the first sale with replayed true and sells nothing.

productId.description: The exact printing id, from spellbook_printings_search or spellbook_inventory_holdings. Required; a wrong id sells the wrong card.

salePricePerUnit.description: Price received PER COPY in USD, before any fee. Not the order total. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that held the sold copies, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_sale_record
